title: Welcome To Hanoi
events: Hospitality desk in the Business Center (hotel staff can confirm any location change). Please bring your completed guest information form, signed Vespa tour waiver, printed color copy of your Cambodian visa, Vietnamese visa, passport, and three completed menu choices.
Welcome Reception (location to be confirmed).
Welcome Dinner at Le Beaulieu Restaurant.
note: Times and activities are subject to change.

title: Hanoi Sightseeing - Water Puppets
events: Breakfast is served at Spice Garden and Le Club Bar.

Depart from the lobby for a 45-minute ride through the old city on Club cars, return to the hotel for a quick break before leaving by coach for the Presidential Palace, Ho Chi Minh’s Mausoleum, Hanoi Hilton and One Pillar Pagoda.
Lunch at Ly Club restaurant.
Approximate arrival at Hotel.
Depart from the lobby for the Water Puppet performance.
Return to hotel. Dinner is on your own tonight.
Checked tagged luggage will be picked up OUTSIDE your room. No power bank in checked luggage.
note: Times and activities are subject to change.

title: Hanoi To Danang And The Rainforests
events: Early Breakfast opening in Spice Garden restaurant .
Depart for the airport. Vietnam Airlines to Danang VN163/8:05-9:30. Enjoy a two hours drive to Hue and visit Emperor Tu Duc Mausoleum.
Arrive at La Residence Hotel and Spa in Hue for check in and lunch.
Depart hotel on a Cyclo tour of Hue citadel / Imperial city and Purple Forbidden City.
Return to hotel. Dinner tonight is in Le Parfum restaurant from 18:30
note: Times and activities are subject to change.

title: Hue - Da Nang
events: Breakfast opens at Le Parfum restaurant.
Checked luggage OUTSIDE you room ready for pick up.
Depart hotel to visit Thien Mu Pagoda followed by Perfume River cruise.
Drive along the Highway #1 to the Vedana Lagoon Resort, beautiful scenic road.
lunch at Horizon restaurant in Vedana Lagoon Resort.
Drive to Danang.
Arrival at Furama Resort. Located on China Beach. Dinner is tonight in any of the Furama’s fine restaurants.; Café Indochine, Don Cipriani or the Steak House.
note: Times and activities are subject to change.

title: Farming Village And Hoi An, Unesco Site
events: Breakfast opens at Cafe Indochine.
Depart for a visit to a local farming village followed by a drive to Hoi An. Transfer onto Cyclos to better see this UNESCO World Heritage Site.
Time to explore the city. Lots of great choices for lunch and shopping.
Departure back to Furama hotel for those who want more time at the resort. You can also choose to come back later. I will arrange it for you.
DINNER
Dinner at your choice of restaurant. Café Indochine, Don Cipriani or the Steak House.
note: Times and activities are subject to change.

title: Saigon - Cu Chi Tunnels
events: Breakfast opens at Cafe Indochine Luggage pick up OUTSIDE the room.
Depart hotel for Danang Airport.
Flight departure for Saigon: VN113/9:55-11:30
Depart for Cu Chi Tunnels, boxed lunch served on the way to the tunnels, 90 minutes drive.
Tour the Tunnels. After the tour we head back to Saigon. Two hour visit.
Arrive at Park Hyatt Saigon.
DINNER
Dinner tonight is at Square One Restaurant.
note: Times and activities are subject to change.

title: Saigon City Tour And Vespa Tour At Night
events: Breakfast opens in Cafe Opera ( lobby level)

Depart for Saigon tour. See the bustling Ben Tanh market, the Presidential palace, serving as the seat of government for South Vietnam during the war. Our tour continues as we see the Notre Dame Cathedral and the Eiffel inspired Post Office.
Lunch at Opera restaurant in the hotel. Free time for rest of the afternoon.
foodie and nightlights tour of Saigon by VESPA, new addition to the tour.
Estimated return to the Hotel, or later if you decide to have a little extra fun!
note: Times and activities are subject to change.

title: Siem Reap, Cambodia
events: Breakfast opens at Cafe Opera and Square One.
Luggage pick up from INSIDE the rooms.
Depart for the airport. Going through passport and security control, it can take over an hour if crowded at Saigon airport.
Flight departure to Siem Reap: K6 825 13:00/14:20
Clearing Cambodia immigration and customs on arrival.
Afternoon tour to Ta Prohm temple, the Tomb Raider movie temple (where trees and roots grow out of the temple ruins), Ancient city of Angkor Thom and Bayon temple.
note: Times and activities are subject to change.

title: Sunrise At Angkor Wat & Tonle Sap Lake
intro: Conservative dress code all day today, shorts are fine as long as they cover your knees.
events: Coffee, tea and cookies will be served in the lobby area.
Depart to visit Angkor Wat, sure to be one of the highlights of your tour to Asia.
Return to hotel for Breakfast.
Depart to Tonle Sap Lake. Our private boat tour will reveal the hard life of the people living in the floating villages of this largest freshwater lake in Southeast Asia.
Lunch at Sokkhak River Side restaurant in Siem Reap town.
Return to hotel.
PM
A La Carte dinner at Cafe D’Angkor or the 1932.
note: Conservative dress code all day today, shorts are fine as long as they cover your knees. Times and activities are subject to change.

title: Siem Reap To Bangkok To Chiang Mai
events: Checked luggage OUTSIDE rooms for pick up.
Breakfast opens at Cafe D’Angkor.
Depart for the airport, around 45 minutes ride.
Flight departure for Bangkok: TG1589 9:50/10:55
Arrival at Bangkok’s Suvarnbhumi international airport. We will clear Thai immigration here. Remember to have your passport, Thai QR code, both boarding passes.
Flight departure for Chiang Mai: TG110 13:25/14:40
On arrival in Chiang Mai, follow signage for International Baggage Claim, we will clear Thai Customs here. Tour the Old Walled City of Chiang Mai before going to the hotel.
Arrive at Intercontinental our home for the next three nights.
Thai Welcome Dinner and traditional show as we enjoy dinner.
note: Times and activities are subject to change.

title: Kanta Elephant Sanctuary - Hill Tribe Village
events: Breakfast opens at The Gad Lanna Terrace.

Depart for Kanta elephant sanctuary. Dress casually, bring a bathing suit or change of underwear if you want to bathe the elephants. The sanctuary provides their own clothing as well as lockers, changing rooms, towel and showers.
LUNCH
Lunch is catered by the Intercontinental at the elephant sanctuary.

After lunch, we have a fascinating visit to the Mae Rim Hill Tribe Village. See their distinct culture and living conditions. See the Long Neck Karen tribe with their brass neck rings. Bring some Thai Baht if you’re interested to purchase some of their homemade handicrafts. No US cash or cards accepted here.
Return to hotel and rest of the day at leisure.
DINNER
Dinner at your restaurant choice, The Gad Lanna (Northern Thai cuisine) and HONG's Chinese Restaurant.
note: Times and activities are subject to change.

title: Doi Suthep Buddhist Temple
events: Breakfast opens at The Gad Lanna Terrace.
Depart for a visit to DOI SUTHEP temple.
Return to hotel and rest of the day at leisure. Lunch today is on your own.
DINNER
Dinner at hotel at your restaurant choice. Enjoy our last night in Chiang Mai!!
note: Times and activities are subject to change.

title: Bangkok - Krung Thep - City Of Angels
events: Checked luggage OUTSIDE rooms for pick up.
Breakfast opens.
Depart for Airport. Bangkok Airways: 10:10. Arriving in Bangkok at 11:35.
lunch on arrival at Rosewood Hotel.
Depart by Skytrain. Bangkok’ BTS or SKYTRAIN connects the whole city by an overhead rail line.
Return to hotel.
PM
Dinner is tonight at hotel’s Nan Bei restaurant (19th floor). Please, make your dinner reservation time at lunch today.
note: Times and activities are subject to change.

title: Klongs Of Old Bangkok & Temple Of Dawn
events: Breakfast opens at Lakorn restaurant.
Depart to River City on the Chao Phraya River for boat tour.
Cross the river and visit to Bangkok’s Iconic Wat Arun (the Temple of Dawn)
Transfer to our special canal boat for a fascinating tour through the canals (Klongs) of Old Bangkok, known as the Venice of the East
lunch at famous Sorndaeng restaurant (Michelin Star)
Return to Rosewood hotel and rest of the ay at leisure.
DINNER
Dinner tonight is on your own, see suggestions sheet
note: Times and activities are subject to change.

title: Reclining Buddha - Emerald Buddha / Palace
events: Breakfast opens on 7th floor.
Depart for the Highlight temples of Bangkok
Visit the temple of the Emerald Buddha and the Grand Palace, shorts not allowed.
A police escorted Tuk Tuk ride through the streets of Bangkok.

Visit to Wat Po, famous temple of the Reclining Buddha, more than 140 feet long and 50 feet high. The complex contains beautiful traditional Thai architecture and home to the teaching school for traditional Thai massage.
Return to hotel and rest of the day at leisure.
Farewell cocktail reception at Lennon’s Bar on 30th floor!!
Farewell dinner at Pavilion room, on 5th floor!!
note: BRING COMMENT CARDS Times and activities are subject to change.

title: Safe Travel Home! See You Soon, I Hope !
events: Safe travel home! See you soon, I hope!
note: Times and activities as provided in the supplied itinerary; subject to change.
